composite_reference.role: original visual reference; not rendered for mutable pasture tufts in this DEV mode
composite_reference.prompt: Use case: game asset. Asset type: DEV scene background under an orthogonal tile grid, cozy farming adventure. Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are style references only for their shared high-detail pixel-art surfaces, warm natural lighting, rich controlled color and polished crafted quality; do not recreate their scenes or subjects. Original working pasture outside a small rural farm, strict orthogonal top-down view directly overhead, no isometric or perspective angle, wide landscape aspect about 11:7. A broad clearly passable horizontal dirt lane crosses from an open portal gap at the west edge around mid-height toward a timber livestock barn entrance on the east side. Reserve a clear opening at the west edge and an unobstructed approach to the barn. Two or three distinct fenced green paddocks with grass tufts, feeding trough, water basin, stacked hay, small shade tree, wildflowers and shrubs; fencing and barn walls are clearly solid blocking features with visible gates. Make paddock gates usable and the lane wide and clean for movement. One clear interaction landmark is a trough near lower-left paddock; another is a gate latch/notice board outside the barn. High-detail pixel art with crisp intentional pixel clusters, tactile worn wood fences, lush grass, hay and stone, warm afternoon sun and grounded shadows. Scene background only behind separate gameplay collision/interaction tiles; not an atlas. No people, animals, UI, text, labels, signs with lettering, logos, border, photorealism, blur, or copied assets.
